label: GL Activity by Distribution Code
description: GL lines of frozen financial transactions in an accounting-date window by distribution code and GL account: lines, debits, credits and net, with a month-by-month breakdown under each code.
subreport: reports/subreports/gl_by_distribution_code_month.jrxml  (a local jrxml resource of the unit named gl_by_distribution_code_month; the main says repo:gl_by_distribution_code_month)

inputControls.label: Distribution code (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(dst_id) AS CODE, TRIM(dst_id) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_DST_CODE_L l WHERE l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_FT_GL g WHERE g.dst_id = l.dst_id) ORDER BY 1

inputControls.label: GL division (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(gl_division) AS CODE, TRIM(gl_division) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_GL_DIVISION_L l WHERE l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_FT f WHERE f.gl_division = l.gl_division) ORDER BY 1

inputControls.label: CIS division (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(cis_division) AS CODE, TRIM(cis_division) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_CIS_DIVISION_L l WHERE l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_ACCT a WHERE a.cis_division = l.cis_division) ORDER BY 1

inputControls.label: FT type (BS, BX, AD, AX, PS, PX) (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(field_value) AS CODE, TRIM(field_value) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_LOOKUP_VAL_L l WHERE l.field_name = 'FT_TYPE_FLG' AND l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_FT f WHERE f.ft_type_flg = l.field_value) ORDER BY 1
